text: Sources: revised ClassMic A2, B2 and C1. The C1 LMS brief https://lms.mbzuai.ac.ae/mod/assign/view.php?id=38960 requests a draft with explicit confirmations, at most two pages and three slides. All measures are proposed. Ready-speaker trials measure time from instructor approval to audible speech. Transport delay is separate, with median and 95th percentile reported and a selected 95th percentile target of 150 milliseconds.
